target.description: Reproduce the original biological findings on stimulus selectivity and decorrelation, reward-predictive activity and pretraining-related learning benefit, using each named result's source-defined cohorts and indispensable controls. Retinotopy is supporting anatomical methodology and cannot substitute for these empirical findings.

dataset.description: Use the original paper-associated all-cell calcium-derived neural activity, behavior, experiment information and anatomical transforms. Figshare article 28811129 version 2 is the intended existing release; its exact files, publication-version relation and result-specific observation manifests remain unjoined. Do not replace it with a third-party neuron subsample or a reference-mouse retinotopy dataset.

cohort.description: Use a separate complete original cohort for each named result. Figure 1j reports 4 task mice, 9 unrewarded natural-image-exposure mice and 3 grating-exposure mice with 5 sessions; Figure 2f reports 5 task, 7 unrewarded-exposure and 9 naive mice with 11 naive sessions; reward fractions and response-timecourse exclusions have their own source populations. Figure 5 uses new groups of 11 natural-image-pretrained, 7 grating-pretrained and 5 no-pretraining mice. Exact animal/session/cell joins and repeated-session treatment remain unresolved; no universal cohort or independent-session assumption is imposed.

split.description: Preserve original longitudinal exposure history and each result's actual trial roles. Sequence selection/reference/repeat/novel-stimulus splits and full-session normalization follow a source recipe still requiring paper/code adjudication; reward-population timecourses use their own ten-fold selection/held-fold procedure, distinct from reward-fraction estimation. Behavior retains passive reward and active-day chronology. Do not introduce an animal-held-out prediction task or force every animal into every stage.

inputs.description: Permitted scientific inputs are original deconvolved neural activity, source cell/area assignments, frame and trial stimulus/movement/corridor identities, cue and lick events, source reward-category labels, chronological exposure/session information and original behavior cohorts. Region assignment may consume supplied retinotopy transforms; natural-image encoding-fit outputs are not the primary response variables.

preprocessing.description: Preserve all source cells and original denominators, frame alignment, moving-texture masks, source interpolation/normalization, trial selection and area mapping. Pinned utilities provide arithmetic-SD d-prime, original reward early/late definitions and behavioral zone/trial selection. Complete native preparation has not been qualified, and sequence threshold/trial-split and figure-specific similarity-index disagreements must be resolved explicitly rather than silently harmonized.

metric.description: Original quantities include all-cell area selectivity fractions and d-prime, per-recording sequence peak-position Pearson correlations, coding-direction projections and figure-specific similarity indices, reward-predictive fractions and cue/lick-aligned response curves, and behavioral response probabilities/differences plus indispensable exposure and licking controls. The scalar findings below enumerate selected named source panels only. Complete original numerical targets, vector-output verification and scientifically justified reproduction tolerances are not frozen; no new scalar whole-paper score is defined.

aggregation.description: Reconstruct source per-cell/per-trial quantities first, then each original session/animal/result reduction, source means and SEM and appropriate paired or independent comparisons. Preserve repeated-session and source exclusion identities. Pinned figure scripts average their supplied records; exact record-to-animal correspondence remains to be authenticated. The existing evaluator's prospective equal-session/equal-animal reduction cannot automatically replace a publication aggregation.

full_panel.description: This standalone partial proposal enumerates source scalar cells in Figures 1j, 2f, 4g and 5f within the biological primary scope. For any admitted named result, retain its complete source cohort and indispensable controls: selectivity exposure/grating, threshold/polarity/area and running comparisons; sequence repeat/reciprocal-stimulus and representation/behavior checks; reward nonreward, cue/lick/movement and source held-fold dynamics; and the three-cohort learning curves with separate rewarded/nonrewarded responses, first-lick, trial-count and within-day controls. Coding-direction/orthogonalization findings and required vector controls remain incompletely represented and blocked. No result is admitted from a subset of cells, and no automatic every-figure, universal-cohort or whole-paper obligation is asserted.

permitted_observations.description: A future paper-plus-data and paper-plus-data-plus-author-code comparison must share the identical authentic result-specific observations, source paper, exposure history, allowed feedback and cumulative budgets; authenticated author code must be the only information addition. Published results are known answers, so executed analysis and source-native granular derivation must be independently verified. No common delivery, submitted-analysis interface, protected operator boundary or paired protocol is frozen, and no mixed biological-reproduction/retinotopy-improvement bundle is available.
